name: io.github.Toraastrta/sphior-code-mcp
description: Deterministic SAST/SCA findings + fix guidance for your AI agent. Runs locally, no account needed.

environmentVariables.name: SPHIOR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it the server runs in local mode: it scans your workspace with the bundled deterministic engine and returns fix guidance. Set it to also reach the repositories you connected to SPHIOR on GitHub, with their history and verifiable scan records. Create one under Settings → API at https://sphior.com/app?settings=api

environmentVariables.name: SPHIOR_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Directory to scan in local mode. Defaults to the directory your client launches the server in.

environmentVariables.name: SPHIOR_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL for self-hosted / regional deployments. Default: https://sphior.com/api/v1

environmentVariables.name: SPHIOR_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Local scan and request timeout in milliseconds (1000–300000). Default: 30000
